subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should a workflow-security owner approve these fourteen upstream Action revisions for the credentialed release, token, Codex-agent, and scanning workflows after validating the refreshed merge result?
rationale: The PR changes trusted third-party executable revisions in workflows carrying credentials and publication authority; deciding whether each upstream contract change is acceptable requires repository-specific trust and release-owner judgment.

options.title: Validate pins and merge
options.body: Verify each updated action revision and run the affected privileged workflows on the refreshed head, then merge if the redacted evidence confirms unchanged credential and publication behavior.

options.title: Pause the group update
options.body: Hold this bundled update until the workflow-security owner can review the upstream release changes or split high-trust actions into separately auditable PRs.

recommendation.title: Validate pins and merge
recommendation.body: Verify each updated action revision and run the affected privileged workflows on the refreshed head, then merge if the redacted evidence confirms unchanged credential and publication behavior.
